item.title: Travis Scott Was ‘Actually Nervous’ When He Shot His Scenes For ‘The Odyssey’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show! Today, we're talking about the one and only Travis Scott. The rapper has been on a hot streak lately, and it's not just his music that's making headlines. Let's dive in.
[Short music transition]
Host: Travis Scott has made his feature acting debut in Christopher Nolan's new film, The Odyssey. He plays The Bard, a character who narrates the story of Odysseus through song. And it looks like his acting career is off to a great start, with the film raking in $123.5 million domestically and $263.7 million globally. That's the biggest live-action opening weekend result for 2026.
[Short music transition]
Host: But it wasn't all smooth sailing for Scott. In an interview on The Tonight Show, he admitted to being nervous during filming, especially with the star-studded cast watching him. However, with the support of director Christopher Nolan and the rest of the cast, he was able to shine. And shine he did, with his song "When I'm Home" featuring in the film's closing credits.
[Short music transition]
Host: And if that's not enough, Scott has also been making waves in the sports world. He recently met with Norway striker Erling Haaland, who wore a soccer boot designed by Scott in a tournament. As a thank you, Haaland gave Scott a signed jersey, and the two shared the moment on social media.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Travis Scott is definitely on a roll, and we can't wait to see what he does next. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!
